principles.title: Curiosity
principles.body: Most opportunities are found by people who kept asking after everyone else stopped. We spend an unreasonable amount of time reading, travelling and listening before we form a view — and we hold that view loosely until the market argues back.

principles.title: Selection
principles.body: A platform is defined by what it declines. We would rather run three ventures that deserve our full attention than fifteen that receive a fraction of it. Concentration is not caution; it is the only way craft survives scale.

principles.title: Craft
principles.claim: The detail is not a finishing layer.
principles.body: Quality is decided upstream — in sourcing, in specification, in who is hired first. We build ventures where the standard is set before the first customer arrives, because a standard retrofitted is a standard already lost.

principles.title: Credibility
principles.body: We would rather be trusted in ten rooms than known in a thousand. Every commitment we make is one we intend to be measured against, and we do not describe as finished what is still in progress.

principles.title: Global relevance
principles.claim: Build for the buyer, wherever they stand.
principles.body: A venture that only makes sense at home has a ceiling. From day one we ask whether the product would hold its own in Milan, Dubai or Melbourne — not because those markets are better judges, but because they are unforgiving ones.

principles.title: Local authenticity
principles.claim: Do not sand off the origin.
principles.body: The island is not a cost centre or a backdrop. It is the reason the product is interesting. We build with local makers, local material and local knowledge, and we pay for it properly, because provenance that is not true is just decoration.

principles.title: The long horizon
principles.claim: We measure in decades, not quarters.
principles.body: Compounding is the only advantage available to everyone and taken by almost no one. We structure ventures so they can be held — modest fixed costs, real margins, and no need to sell at the wrong moment.

principles.title: Bridge-building
principles.body: Carrying Sri Lanka outward is half the mandate. The other half is bringing capital, standards, partners and ideas back in — and leaving something behind that is more capable than what we found.
